checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Online stocks and ETFs
facts.text: $0 online commission for listed stocks and ETFs. U.S. OTC equities cost $6.95; broker-assisted trades generally add $25.

facts.label: Options
facts.text: $0 base online commission plus $0.65 per contract; other applicable fees remain.

facts.label: Mutual funds
facts.text: Schwab Mutual Fund OneSource funds have $0 online transaction fees. Other mutual-fund purchases can cost up to $74.95.

facts.label: Account minimums
facts.text: Individual and joint brokerage accounts and traditional, Roth, and rollover IRAs list $0 opening and maintenance fees and $0 account minimums. Investment-specific requirements may differ.
